boxes.meaning: sound like, seem from what you hear

english.note: Use 聽落 as the all-purpose way to say that someone or something seems a certain way from its sound.
Use this when the impression comes specifically from how something sounds or from what you hear.
Use this when judging how something sounds, especially whether it sounds true or plausible.

examples.english: This song has quite a pleasant sound.
